page.overview:
Who is David Schumacher?

David Schumacher (born 23 October 2001) is a German racing driver who has competed in various junior single-seater categories, including the FIA Formula 3 Championship and the Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM). He is the son of former Formula One driver Ralf Schumacher and the nephew of seven-time Formula One World Champion Michael Schumacher. As a member of the famous Schumacher racing family, David has been under close observation throughout his career.

David Schumacher was born in Salzburg, Austria, but races under a German license. He began karting competitively in 2011 and achieved success in German and European karting championships. Initially racing under his mother’s maiden name, David Brinkmann, to avoid media attention, he later reverted to his family name as his career progressed.

Coming from a strong motorsport background, David was surrounded by racing from an early age, with both his father and uncle having enjoyed long Formula One careers. He is also a cousin of racing driver Mick Schumacher.

David Schumacher made his single-seater debut in 2018 in the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ADAC_Formula_4 ADAC Formula 4 Championship] with US Racing–CHRS, a team co-owned by his father, Ralf Schumacher. He finished ninth in the championship and was the best-placed rookie, earning him the Rookie Championship title.
